en.t: They seemed to be talking about me.

units.source_text: 可能是千代子说我的牙齿不整齐，舞女才说出镶金牙的话吧。

en.t: Perhaps Chiyoko had said my teeth were uneven, and that was why the dancer mentioned gold-capped teeth.

units.source_text: 她们无非是议论我的长相，我不至于不愉快。

en.t: They were only talking about my appearance, so I did not feel displeased.

units.source_text: 由于已有一种亲切之情，我也就没有心思去倾听。

en.t: Because I already felt a kind of closeness toward them, I had no inclination to listen closely.

units.source_text: 她们继续低声谈论了一阵子，我听见舞女说：

en.t: They went on talking in low voices for a while, and I heard the dancer say:
